## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

### Lite — Positioning Sprint · $6,500
- **Configuration:** Depth Light · Breadth Positioning-only · Pace Sprint (2 wk) · Format Working docs · Support Async + 1 revision · Complexity New brand or sub-brand · Embed None
- **Positioning:** For early-stage founders who need a defensible positioning statement fast — not a full brand system.
- **Pricing logic:** ~43% of flagship. Anchored against "cost of launching with bad positioning" and DIY brand-sprint workshops in the $3–8K range. Priced to be a no-brainer entry point that seeds Core/Premium upsell.

### Core — Brand Guide *(flagship)* · $15,000
- **Configuration:** Depth Standard (3–6 interviews) · Breadth Full verbal system (excl. naming) · Pace Standard (6 wk) · Format Designed PDF guide · Support Weekly calls + 2 revisions · Complexity New brand or rebrand · Embed None
- **Positioning:** For funded startups and growing companies who need a complete verbal brand system — senior strategist only, no junior handoff.
- **Pricing logic:** Anchored ~50–60% below agency equivalents ($25–50K for comparable scope with senior strategist involvement). Flagship must feel like the rational choice — BYO-summed equivalent lands at ~$17.5K.

### Premium — Brand System + Embed · $32,000
- **Configuration:** Depth Deep (7–10+ interviews incl. customer research) · Breadth Full verbal system + Naming · Pace Extended (10 wk) · Format Designed PDF + agency-handoff brief + rollout kit · Support Slack same-day + unlimited revisions · Complexity any · Embed 90-day
- **Positioning:** For Series A+ companies rebranding or launching a category-defining product — full verbal system, naming, and embedded strategist through rollout.
- **Pricing logic:** Below the sum-of-parts (~$40–45K BYO) and well under consultancy retainers ($50–75K) or naming-agency-only engagements ($25–40K just for naming). Anchored on the cost of a botched rebrand at Series A scale.

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base:** $6,500 (Lite configuration)

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing:**
- Depth: Light → Standard +$3,500 · Standard → Deep +$5,500
- Breadth: +Messaging pillars +$2,000 · +Voice & tone +$1,500 · +Naming +$6,000
- Pace: Sprint → Standard +$1,000 · Standard → Extended +$2,500
- Format: Working docs → Designed PDF +$2,000 · +Handoff brief + rollout kit +$3,000
- Support: Async → Weekly calls +$2,000 · Weekly → Slack same-day +$4,000
- Rebrand Complexity: Rebrand surcharge +$2,500 · Sub-brand +$1,500
- Post-Delivery Embed: 30-day Q&A +$2,000 · 90-day embed +$6,500

**Floor:** $6,500 (Lite base — nothing ships below this)

**Ceiling:** $28,000 — any BYO configuration exceeding this auto-routes to Premium or triggers custom-scope conversation

**Dependencies the configurator must enforce:** all invalid combinations from Part 2

**Flagship-protection check:**
- Core config via BYO = $6,500 + $3,500 (Depth) + $2,000 (Messaging) + $1,500 (Voice) + $1,000 (Standard pace) + $2,000 (Designed PDF) + $2,000 (Weekly calls) = **$18,500** — safely above the $15K flagship ✓
- Premium config via BYO = $6,500 + $5,500 + $2,000 + $1,500 + $6,000 (Naming) + $2,500 (Extended) + $2,000 + $3,000 + $4,000 + $6,500 = **$39,500** — safely above the $32K flagship ✓

### Build-Your-Own Framework

- **Base price:** Lite (**+$A/mo**) — Semi-custom + Monthly support + Async
- **Per-dimension upgrade pricing** (indicative structure, re-anchor with your rate):
  - Depth: Semi-custom → Fully custom = +$X
  - Support: each cadence step up = +$Y
  - Pace: each frequency step up = +$Y
  - Format: add weekly call = +$Y · add live-coached sessions = +$Z (per session/mo)
  - Nutrition: Guidelines → Macros = +$Y · Macros → Full planning = +$Z
  - Accountability: each level up = +$Y
  - Add-ons: form-check videos +$Y/mo · event peak +$Z one-time
- **Floor:** +$A/mo — below this, refer to app/template product

- **Flagship-protection rule:** BYO'ing Core's exact configuration must price **10–15% above** Core's flat rate. BYO'ing Premium's exact config must price **20–25% above** Premium. Flagships remain the rational choice for anyone who wants the "full" experience.

## What you likely want instead

**SKU + bundle logic**, not service productization. That means:

- **Variants** — leather type (vegetable-tanned, chromexcel, bridle), color, thread color, stitching style, monogram/initials

- **Tiers by material/finish** — Standard ($120) / Premium leather ($180) / Exotic or hand-dyed ($260)

That's product-line architecture, and it's a different discipline (closer to merchandising and pricing ladders than service modularization).

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

Renamed in the offering's vocabulary: **Open / Studio / Foundry**, with **BYO (Kiln)** underneath and between.

### Open — Free (current OSS, unchanged)
- **Configuration:** Personal license · Generic only · Community support · No memory · Schema only · Annual snapshot · IC-branded · No certification
- **Positioning:** The MIT skill as it exists today, for any solo operator who wants to productize their own service and is happy to self-serve.
- **Pricing logic:** $0. Anchors the entire ladder; every paid tier must clearly out-value it. Also the top-of-funnel — every Studio/Foundry buyer starts here.

### Studio *(flagship)* — `+$A / year`
- **Configuration:** Team license (≤10 seats) · 3 vertical packs · Async blueprint review (3/quarter) · claude-mem + benchmark read · Schema + template · Quarterly updates · Co-branded allowed · Self-paced certification
- **Positioning:** For working consultants/coaches/small agencies actively productizing 2–10 offerings per year who need vertical templates, async expert review, and benchmark data to price with confidence.
- **Pricing logic:** Anchored against the cost of a *single* botched productization (mispriced flagship, un-scoped BYO). Priced well below one hour of the buyer's own senior consulting rate × the hours saved per blueprint. Sum-of-parts via BYO must exceed Studio price by a clear margin.

### Foundry — `+$B / year`
- **Configuration:** Agency-Reseller license · All packs + custom pack authoring · White-glove (unlimited blueprints) · Benchmark read+contribute · Schema + template + impl review · Continuous updates · White-label · Proctored certification + directory listing
- **Positioning:** For agencies, incubators, and platforms who productize *other people's* services as a line of business and need to ship configurators under their own brand.
- **Pricing logic:** Anchored against (a) the retainer for a fractional productization consultant (~$C/mo range once named) and (b) reseller economics — Foundry pays for itself after N resold blueprints. Priced below custom-consultancy engagement, above sum-of-Studio-parts.

### Build-Your-Own (Kiln)

- **Base price:** Open (free) is the floor. Kiln = Open + à la carte upgrades, billed annually or per-atom.
- **Per-dimension upgrade pricing (tokens until niche is anchored):**
  - License: Team `+$L1`, Reseller `+$L2`, Platform `+$L3`
  - Vertical pack: `+$V` each (volume discount at 3+, included in All-packs at `+$V_all`)
  - Support: Async review `+$S1/quarter`, Live co-pro `+$S2/session`, White-glove `+$S3/blueprint`
  - Memory: claude-mem setup `+$M1` one-time, Benchmark read `+$M2/yr`, Contribute tier `+$M3/yr`
  - Configurator: Template `+$C1`, Impl review `+$C2`, Fully-built `+$C3`
  - Updates: Quarterly `+$U1`, Continuous `+$U2`
  - Branding: Co-brand `+$B1`, White-label `+$B2`
  - Certification: Self-paced `+$Cert1`, Proctored `+$Cert2`

- **Floor:** Any paid Kiln config must include at least one of {Async review, 1 vertical pack, claude-mem setup}. Below that, route buyer back to Open — don't fragment revenue on sub-$100 configs.

- **Ceiling:** If Kiln config sum exceeds Foundry price × 0.9, auto-route to Foundry (cheaper and includes more). If buyer needs beyond Foundry (multi-brand white-label, custom pack authoring at platform scale, embedded in a SaaS), route to **custom Platform-Embed quote** — not a listed tier.

- **Configurator dependencies to enforce (repeated from Part 2 for the builder):**
  - White-label → requires Reseller+
  - Fully-built configurator → requires White-glove
  - Custom pack authoring → requires Team+
  - Benchmark contribute → requires Team+ and consent
  - Proctored cert → requires ≥1 live workshop atom in cart

- **Flagship-protection rule:**
  - Kiln-summed equivalent of Studio's configuration must price **above** Studio's `+$A` — verify: `$L1 + 3·$V + $S1×4 + $M1 + $M2 + $C1 + $U1 + $B1 + $Cert1 > $A`. If not, either raise per-atom prices or lower Studio; do not ship until it holds.
  - Kiln-summed equivalent of Foundry's configuration must price **above** `+$B` by an even wider margin (Foundry buyers get bulk + white-glove; parts should feel painful).
  - Open must remain genuinely useful standalone — do not cripple it to drive Studio conversion. Studio wins on *leverage per blueprint*, not on unlocking basic functionality.
